tools.name: create_plan
tools.description:
Use when the user wants to lay out, furnish, fit furniture into, or get a floor plan of a room or home: returns a checked plan, a drawing, and an editable Room Planner link. One room or a whole floor (rooms joined by doors), any outline, round and L-shaped pieces.
Returns {plan, issues, summary, url

tools.name: check_layout
tools.description:
Use when a plan only needs checking, without making a link or a drawing: returns the same issues as create_plan. The plan format is in create_plan's description.
Returns {ok, issues, summary}; ok is true when no issue is an error or a warning. Each issue is {code, severity, message, ids}, ids naming

tools.name: read_plan
tools.description: Use when the user shares a Room Planner link, to read and modify that plan. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_plan, check_layout, read_plan · Public sink: read_plan · Destructive: create_plan, check_layout, read_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_plan, check_layout, read_plan · Public sink: read_plan · Destructive: create_plan, check_layout, read_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
